jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Platform/Core), you will help build the core infrastructure and product systems that power the Confido platform. This includes everything from large-scale data pipelines and financial analytics systems to AI-powered workflows used by leading CPG brands.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and customers to turn complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable software.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do

  • Build and scale the core platform that powers financial workflows for CPG brands

  • Develop systems for ingesting and processing financial and operational data from multiple sources

  • Build backend services and APIs that power analytics, forecasting, and automation features

  • Implement AI-powered workflows for document processing and financial data extraction

  • Design intuitive product experiences that turn complex financial data into actionable insights

  • Work directly with product and occasionally customers to understand workflows and ship solutions quickly

Example Problems

  • AI-powered ingestion of invoices, deductions, and retailer reports

  • Scaling data pipelines that ingest financial data from multiple retailer systems

  • Building analytics infrastructure for forecasting and demand planning

  • Designing internal tools and product features that simplify complex financial workflows

  • Improving performance and reliability across core platform services

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience

  • Strong backend engineering skills and systems design experience

  • Comfort building production systems that handle large datasets or complex workflows

  • Strong product instincts and ability to work across engineering and product

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with AI/ML-powered systems

  • Experience with data pipelines or analytics infrastructure

  • Experience working directly with customers or cross-functional stakeholders

  • Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles

  • CS degree or equivalent experience

More about Engineering @ Confido

🌴 Perks + Benefits

  • Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build

  • Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums

  • Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian

  • Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support

  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take

jobs.descriptionHtml:

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.


The Role

Build the core AI behind Confido — and get your hands on an unusually rich, messy dataset: hundreds of thousands of documents across dozens of sources and hundreds of layouts and contexts, much of it beyond what any system reads well today.

As a Senior Applied AI / ML Engineer, you'll own AI problems end to end — research, prototyping, production, and the evaluation that keeps probabilistic systems reliable — across document understanding, forecasting, and agentic workflows.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)



What you'll do

  • Build LLM systems that turn complex, inconsistent financial documents into clean, typed, validated data — the backbone the rest of the platform runs on

  • Design agentic workflows that retrieve and reason over fragmented enterprise systems, with the eval harnesses and guardrails to run them in production

  • Build and improve demand forecasting across thousands of intermittent series — classical time-series and gradient-boosted models, with rolling-origin backtesting and best-fit selection

  • Wrangle messy, real-world data: baselining, outlier and anomaly detection, entity reconciliation, and ingestion across heterogeneous sources

  • Own how we measure success — eval datasets, benchmarks, and monitoring for systems with no single "correct" answer


What we're looking for


Required

  • 5+ years of applied AI / ML, with systems you've taken to production (not just prototypes)

  • Depth in at least one, and working fluency across several, of: time-series / forecasting and statistical modeling; LLM and agentic systems; large-scale messy-data engineering

  • You build evaluation and monitoring as a matter of course — and know which metric to trust, and how to avoid leakage and train/serve skew

  • Strong product sense: you turn AI capability into real outcomes, and know when a simpler approach wins

Nice to have

  • Demand forecasting / time-series (Prophet, ARIMA-family, gradient-boosted)

  • Agentic workflows, RAG, or retrieval systems in production

  • Document understanding / information extraction from unstructured sources

  • Startup experience or comfort in fast-moving environments

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will help architect and build the core systems that power the Confido platform. You’ll lead the development of major product and infrastructure initiatives—from AI-powered document ingestion to large-scale financial analytics systems.

This role combines deep technical ownership with product impact, working closely with engineering, product, and customers to turn complex operational workflows into scalable software.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead the design and development of major platform and product systems

 - Architect scalable infrastructure for financial data processing and analytics

 - Build systems that ingest and process financial data across multiple sources

 - Develop AI-powered workflows for document ingestion and financial automation

 - Partner with product and leadership to shape technical strategy and roadmap

 - Mentor engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team

 - Designing product experiences that simplify complex financial workflows

 - Improving performance, reliability, and scalability of core platform systems

Required

 - Proven ability to build and scale complex production systems

Confido will grow more than 4x this year, while growing headcount by 2x. We're obsessed with concentrating our best leads with world class sellers.

What you’ll do:

  • Build target account lists: Identify the brands that should be Confido customers and turn them into focused, high-quality prospecting lists

  • Prospect and run outbound: Reach decision-makers through sharp, personalized outreach via written and over the phone. Run your own sequences end to end

  • Own your book: Carry a large book of accounts in your name, prioritize the right contacts, and generate real pipeline for the sales team

  • Learn the CPG buyer: Get deep on how consumer brands operate and the problems Confido solves for them

What we're looking for:

  • Relevant experience: 1+ year meeting and exceeding quota in an SDR/BDR role, or 1+ year in consulting, investment banking, or investing

  • Bonus: Experience in CPG or familiarity with how consumer brands operate

CPG brands live and die by their ability to predict what’s coming — how much product will sell, where demand will land, and what a promotion will actually do to the business. At Confido, you’ll build models that help brands forecast sales, price products, and shape promotional strategy. You’ll work with an unusually broad dataset spanning sell-through, inventory, deductions, trade promotions, and supply-chain signals from 200+ brands — much of it messy, real-world data that makes the problems genuinely interesting. The models you build will directly influence decisions behind the products you see on store shelves every day.

As a Data Scientist, you'll turn that data into models and analyses that ship inside the product — not slide decks. You'll work alongside our AI/ML engineering team to move from exploratory analysis to production-grade insight.

What you'll work on

  • Demand and sales forecasting — improving prediction quality across thousands of noisy, real-world retail time series

  • Promotion effectiveness — measuring lift, price elasticity, and cannibalization so brands know which promotions actually pay

  • Data quality and evaluation — building the statistical checks that keep our models honest as messy data flows in

About you

  • 3-5+ years of hands-on data science experience with real-world (not benchmark) data

  • Strong statistical foundations: regression, time-series methods, experiment design, uncertainty quantification

  • Fluent in Python and SQL; comfortable working in a modern data stack (we use Snowflake and dbt)

  • You care whether your analysis is right, not just whether it runs — you validate, sanity-check, and communicate uncertainty

  • You can explain a model to a non-technical brand operator and defend it to an ML engineer

Bonus

  • Experience with retail, CPG, supply chain, or demand-planning data

  • Experience shipping models into production systems (vs. offline analysis only)

  • Familiarity with forecasting at scale (hierarchical forecasting, intermittent demand)

CPG brands live and die by their ability to predict what’s coming — how much product will sell, where demand will land, and what a promotion will actually do to the business. At Confido, you’ll build models that help brands forecast sales, price products, and shape promotional strategy. You’ll work with an unusually broad dataset spanning sell-through, inventory, deductions, trade promotions, and supply-chain signals from 200+ brands — much of it messy, real-world data that makes the problems genuinely interesting. The models you build will directly influence decisions behind the products you see on store shelves every day.

As a Data Scientist, you'll turn that data into models and analyses that ship inside the product — not slide decks. You'll work alongside our AI/ML engineering team to move from exploratory analysis to production-grade insight.

What you'll work on

  • Demand and sales forecasting — improving prediction quality across thousands of noisy, real-world retail time series

  • Promotion effectiveness — measuring lift, price elasticity, and cannibalization so brands know which promotions actually pay

  • Data quality and evaluation — building the statistical checks that keep our models honest as messy data flows in

The Role

Most B2B software looks the same. A few companies have proven it doesn't have to: brands with real taste, that people follow, wear and want to work for.

Behind every CPG brand you love is a back office nobody sees: the finance lead chasing a deduction at 11pm, the sales team planning a promotion blind, the founder watching margin leak line by line. Confido exists for them. Your job is to tell their story, and ours, so well that people who have never heard the words "trade spend" want to be part of it.

This is a principal-level role. You'll be our first creative brand hire and the keeper of how Confido looks and feels, setting the creative direction for the company and holding the final call on the craft. A new strategy and identity are underway with our agency partner, and you'll take it from a set of guidelines to a brand with a point of view: one customers share, candidates join for, and competitors quietly copy.

You'll own every place someone meets us, from the website and launches to decks, ads, events, video and the brand moments inside our product. As the work grows, you'll build and direct a bench of specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication. You'll report to our VP of Marketing and work closely with the founders.

What You'll Do

  • Be the creative voice in the room. Partner with the founders and marketing leadership on how we tell our story and what the brand stands for

  • Shape the brand from the ground up. Take the new identity from guidelines to a living system with a voice, a point of view and a standard people notice

  • Find the story in the numbers. Turn customer outcomes, like $500K recouped for Feastables or revenue doubled with the same finance team at DUDE Wipes, into campaigns, films and stories people remember

  • Make the invisible visible. Put the people, shelves, pallets and trucks of CPG at the centre of how we show up, never just another dashboard screenshot

  • Own every surface. confido.com, launches, sales and customer decks, ads, social, email and the brand moments inside our product

  • Create moments in the room. Concept and direct our booths, customer dinners and owned events so people leave talking about them. We care deeply about unreasonable hospitality - people should feel that across every experiential surface.

  • Build your bench. Hire and direct specialists across illustration, motion, photography, video production, 3D, presentation design, web development and event fabrication, with the templates, intake and asset library that let them do their best work

  • Make brand and product one. Partner with our product design team so every touchpoint feels like the same company

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in brand design, art direction or creative direction, in-house, at an agency, or both, including time leading brand for a company or major client

  • You're a storyteller first. You can take a complex, unglamorous idea and make people feel something about it

  • A portfolio with a brand system you built or scaled, and work you're proud to show anyone

  • Taste you can defend. You know the difference between good and world class

  • Range: you can move from identity and web to a sales deck, a booth and a photo shoot in the same week

  • Hands-on craft in Figma. You sweat the kerning and what the work does for the business

  • You own work from concept to production, including vendors, printers, fabricators and budgets

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

THE ROLE

Every day, Confido processes remittances, deductions, retailer disputes, and trade spend for some of the fastest-growing brands in CPG. When our platform is down or slow, a customer’s cash gets stuck. We’re hiring a DevOps Engineer to own the infrastructure and tooling that keeps the platform fast, safe, and easy to ship to.

You’ll work across AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, observability, and security. Your goal is to make it easier for every engineer at Confido to ship confidently, debug quickly, and operate production without heroics. This is a hands-on role. You’ll split your time between planned platform projects and whatever production needs today. You’ll work closely with our product engineers and engineering leadership. We expect you to form your own opinions about where the platform needs to go and then make it happen.

Location: New York, NY (in office; relocation supported)


What You’ll Do

  • Own and improve our production infrastructure on AWS, including Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, S3, networking, IAM, and load balancing.

  • Manage infrastructure as code in Terraform so that every change is reviewable, repeatable, and safe to roll back.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for our Rails, Python, and TypeScript services, including migrations and automated testing.

  • Expand observability across services with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana, so issues surface before customers notice them.

  • Investigate production incidents, find root causes, and ship lasting fixes instead of manual workarounds.

  • Make deployments safer with automated checks, progressive rollouts, and clear rollback paths.

  • Partner with product engineers on local development, test environments, and release workflows.

  • Track capacity, reliability, and cloud spend, and make practical improvements as customer volume grows.

  • Help define our incident response, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.

  • Join a shared on-call rotation, and make on-call better for everyone on it.


What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: You’ll learn our architecture, deployment process, and security controls. You’ll ship changes through the existing pipeline. You’ll review recent incidents and recurring pain points, and start knocking some of them out.

By 60 days: You’ll own a meaningful area, such as CI/CD, observability, deployment reliability, or cloud security. You’ll also deliver improvements that cut manual work or make releases faster and safer.

By 90 days: You’ll land a significant platform improvement with measurable results, such as faster deploys, fewer incidents, better recovery time, stronger security, or lower cloud cost. You’ll also have a prioritized infrastructure roadmap, and you’ll be the person the team trusts on production and platform decisions.


What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 3+ Years of experience building and operating production infrastructure for a software product

  • Strong AWS experience, including a working understanding of networking, compute, storage, databases, and IAM

  • Experience running containerized workloads on Kubernetes

  • Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar)

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

  • Solid instincts for observability, incident investigation, and root-cause analysis

  • Ability to automate operational work in Python, shell, or another language

  • Strong security judgment, since our customers trust us with their financial data

  • The ability to turn messy operational problems into simple, maintainable solutions

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 or similar compliance programs

  • Experience with systems that handle financial, payments, or other sensitive data

  • Experience at an early-stage, high-growth B2B SaaS company

Our Stack

We care much more about strong fundamentals than experience with any particular tool, but today we primarily use AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, PostgreSQL, Python, Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, OpenTelemetry, Grafana/Prometheus, and GitHub Actions.

THE ROLE

Data at Confido feeds customer-facing reports, internal dashboards, and a lot of day-to-day decisions. Right now it lives in too many places and is owned by too many people. We’re hiring a VP of Data Engineering to own all of it: how data gets into our systems, how it’s stored and modeled, and how it shows up in the reports people use, inside the company and out.

You’ll be the single owner of data at Confido. You’ll manage our Senior Analytics Engineer to start, and you’ll build the team from there. Early on you’ll be hands-on. Over time, more of your time will go to hiring, setting direction, and working with the leadership team.


What You’ll Own

  • Ingestion. Every source that feeds our data, including product databases, event tracking, and third-party tools. You decide how data comes in, how often, and what happens when a source changes or breaks.

  • Warehouse and pipelines. Warehouse design, orchestration, and the infrastructure underneath, including its cost.

  • Modeling. One set of core models and metric definitions that the whole company uses.

  • Reporting. Internal dashboards and BI, plus the data behind customer-facing reports. If a number shows up somewhere at Confido, it’s yours.

  • Quality and governance. Testing, monitoring, access controls, and data privacy. You’re accountable when numbers are wrong, and you put fixes in place so the same problems don’t come back.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and lead the data org, starting with our Senior Analytics Engineer. Decide which roles to hire and when, run the interviews, and develop the people you bring on.

  • Set the data roadmap and explain the trade-offs to the leadership team and the rest of the company.

  • Make the big technical calls on architecture, tooling, and build vs. buy.

  • Work with Engineering, Product, Ops, and Customer teams to figure out what data they actually need, and say no when something isn’t worth building.

  • Set the standards the team works by: modeling, testing, docs, monitoring, and on-call.

  • Write SQL, review PRs, and build things yourself while the team is small.


What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or similar, with 4+ years leading data teams.

  • You’ve owned data end to end before, from ingestion through reporting, not just one layer of it.

  • You’ve built a data function from an early or messy state, grown the team, and kept it running.

  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills, and experience with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or similar tools.

  • You’ve hired well, including people senior to where the team started.

  • You can sit in a leadership meeting, turn “we need better data” into a plan, and defend it.

  • You’re comfortable being hands-on now and stepping back as the team grows.

A year in, there’s no question about who owns data at Confido. People trust the numbers and know where to find them. Sources are documented, pipelines break less often, and when they do, the team catches it before a customer does. Internal and customer-facing reports run off the same definitions. About the job

Most product marketers spend their careers making an average product sound better than it is. This role is the opposite.

We have built something rare: AI infrastructure that CPG teams genuinely love and will not give up. The stickiness is real, and category leaders keep choosing us. What we have not done yet is tell the world why we are better, and that gap is wide.

Today our positioning, customer proof, and competitive story are spread thin across the team. Our product is ahead of its story, and you close that gap. You own how our products show up in the market: how each area is positioned, why we win, and how we turn product and customer moments into demand. You power the GTM team with a story sharp enough to sell on, and you help define the category we are building.

This is a founding role. You are one of the first PMMs at Confido, here early enough to shape how the whole function works. Product Marketing reports to the VP of Marketing.

What You'll Own

You own strategy, programming, and the moments: what gets said, to whom, and where. This is a role for someone who wants to make the thing, not brief it out.

Own

  • Positioning, messaging, and narrative for the platform, sharpened as the product evolves

  • Product-market clarity: the ICP, buyer, user, jobs to be done, alternatives, and why customers expand

  • Product launches end to end: the plan, narrative, and cross-functional orchestration that turn new features into pipeline

  • The customer-insight engine: lightweight automations (Gong, HubSpot, Zapier) that turn calls and win/loss into the themes, quotes, and proof that feed positioning and competitive intel

  • GTM enablement: the battlecards, and messaging that arm reps to win

  • Case studies and customer proof, sourced, written, and deployed into Sales hands at the right moment

  • An integrated plan connecting the product roadmap to the marketing calendar across lifecycle, social, partnerships, AEO, and brand moments



How You're Measured

We measure product marketing on the pipeline it moves and the deals it wins, not on activity.

  • Deal velocity and win rate (primary). Sharp positioning and enablement move qualified deals faster and beat the alternatives more often

  • Influenced pipeline and its trajectory. Every deal maps to one of five motions: inbound, outbound, referral, partnerships, upsell. The signal that matters most is trajectory: the share of pipeline we build rather than rent, growing over time

  • Launch impact. New products are measured on adoption and the pipeline they generate, not on shipping

  • Enablement effectiveness. Reps are equipped, using your assets, and able to defend against competitors in live deals

What You'll Need

  • 7+ years in product marketing. This is a clear PMM role, and we want someone who has done the craft, not an adjacent function

  • Ideally in one of two worlds: CPG or commerce software, building the workflows our customers already live in, or B2B technology, where you translated genuinely complex products into clear entry points

  • Excellent writing and narrative instincts. You turn a complex product into sharp, credible positioning

  • Financial and quantitative fluency: comfortable reporting on pipeline influence and deal velocity

The Role

As a Data Analyst, you’ll build and own the data behind Confido’s finance function, reporting to our SVP of Finance. You’ll build the models and analyses that leadership, the board, and investors rely on, and use AI and automation to take manual work out of close, planning, and reporting.

You’re accountable for faster, better decisions, not for the number of dashboards you build.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with our SVP of Finance as the lead analyst for the finance team, turning open-ended questions into clear, data-backed recommendations

  • Design and build the finance data layer in Snowflake and BI tooling, including clean, well-documented data models and pipelines that bring together the ERP, CRM, billing, payroll and operational data into one trusted source of truth

  • Define and maintain core metrics in the semantic layer so reporting holds up for people and AI agents

  • Use AI and automation to remove manual finance and revops work, including reconciliations, anomaly detection, and self-serve reporting

  • Use advanced SQL to explore large, complex datasets and find what’s driving the outcomes

  • Go beyond surface-level numbers to explain the “why” behind performance trends, quantify opportunities and deliver clear recommendation

  • Turn analysis into clear narratives for the executive team, the board, and investors

What We’re Looking For

Must Have:

  • 2 to 4 years of experience as a data analyst, business analyst, or analytics engineer, ideally partnering with Finance or FP&A

  • Advanced SQL skills, especially debugging complex logic

  • Hands-on experience building models in dbt or a similar transformation framework

  • Track record of turning data into recommendations stakeholders act on

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including turning complex analysis into clear takeaways for senior leadership

  • You already use AI to work faster, whether automating repetitive tasks or drafting first-pass analyses

  • Experience with BI tools (Sigma, Omni, Looker, Hex, Tableau, etc.)
